Generated at test time, never committed (`makeRuntimeFixtures()` / `makeBigFixture()` in `build.mjs`):

- `encrypted_userpw_1234.pdf`: pages of `kr_law_form.pdf` encrypted with @cantoo/pdf-lib `encrypt` (user password `1234`, AES-256).
- `damaged_badxref.pdf`: `kr_law_form.pdf` with `startxref` set to 999.
- `truncated.pdf`: the first 60 % of `irs_fw9.pdf`.
- `not_a_pdf.pdf`: 1×1 PNG bytes saved with a `.pdf` name.
- `big_51mb.pdf` (e2e only): 1-page PDF padded with an unreferenced 51 MB stream, for the mobile soft limit.
